events.event: Komdigi issued three advisory letters on 9 Nov to PDN-1/Government Cloud users, government domain managers and all PSE after a BSSN security advisory on 8 Nov warned of possible attacks linked to opposition to the foreign digital transaction tax (SPP-TDLN); BSSN said the threat's authenticity is unverified.
events.key_numbers: 2.2 million attack attempts on Indonesia in 24h to 10 Nov 07:30 (about 26/s, highest in Southeast Asia) · about 1 million aimed at finance · 151 financial-sector incident response teams · 202 BSSN threat notices to them · 96.7% of .go.id PHP servers scanned (1,621 of 1,677) run end-of-life PHP (Vaksincom, 23 Oct)
events.why_it_matters: Government services and banks may be hit by DDoS and phishing, and scammers are already using digital-tax lures.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNN Indonesia, Katadata, Jawapos, Antara, Periskop on 10 Nov

events.event: Security firm ZENTARA said it handled three fund-theft cases at Indonesian financial institutions in eight weeks since August, where attackers used stolen signing keys and staff tokens rather than malware, moving money in 36 minutes to nearly seven hours.
events.key_numbers: 3 cases in 8 weeks (0 in prior 3 months) · 36 minutes to about 7 hours to move funds · 85% of fraud victims report after 12 hours · fraud-linked account blocking up about 53% in Aug-Sep vs Jan-Jul · 702,833 accounts blocked to 30 Sep (IASC) · one institution re-breached 8 days later · about 758,000 servers on unsupported PHP
events.why_it_matters: Shows how institutions holding people's money can be drained fast without any hacking tool, only weak internal controls.

events.event: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang emailed staff on 8 Nov admitting an affair with Alice Huang, a Megaspeed executive suspected by US intelligence of passing information to China; Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation and House committee chairs asked him to a closed-door meeting.
events.key_numbers: Huang net worth about US$162 billion (CNBC; CNN cites about US$75 billion for divorce angle, conflicting) · closed-door House meeting 18 Nov 2026 · Nvidia says Huang remains CEO
events.why_it_matters: The head of the company behind AI chips is under scrutiny over a possible chip-export leak, which could shake the AI boom.
events.spreading_evidence: Dozens of Huang stories across CNBC Indonesia, CNN Indonesia and detikInet front pages 9-10 Nov

events.event: Equinix inaugurated Phase 2 of its JK1 Jakarta data center, adding liquid-cooled capacity and tripling the site's capacity.
events.key_numbers: US$94 million (Rp1.7 trillion) · about 1,125 new cabinets · capacity tripled · liquid cooling up to 150 kVA/cabinet · PUE about 3.02 vs target 1.35 · Indonesia data-centre capacity about 600 MW (Komdigi)
events.why_it_matters: Data-centre building in Indonesia continues even as projects face local opposition and water-use criticism.

events.event: CNN Indonesia reported Oppo may cancel its Find X10 Ultra because the RAM shortage is raising component costs, with the effect expected to last until 2028 (rumour-level report).
events.key_numbers: Memory cost pressure expected to last to 2028 · Omdia: tablet shipments -23% y/y in Q3 2026 to 32 million; Counterpoint: smartphones -20% y/y (CNBC Indonesia, 9 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Phone and tablet prices stay high and some models may never reach shelves.

events.event: Reuters-based reports said data of more than 40,000 US Department of Homeland Security employees leaked, with a group calling itself Department of Peace claiming the hack; DHS confirmed a potential leak and Okta denies being breached.
events.key_numbers: 40,000+ DHS staff (ICE, CBP, CISA) · third major US government breach in about a month · Reuters verified 6 sampled identities
events.why_it_matters: Headline says 'PNS' but the victims are US officials, not Indonesian civil servants, a common source of confusion.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia, citing a Japanese TV programme and CYFIRMA, reported chats from late October allegedly showing North Korean hackers discussing targeting Indonesia, the US, Japan, Thailand and South Korea using AI.
events.key_numbers: About 3,000 North Korean hackers reportedly operate abroad · FBI links group to Binance theft (reported 1 trillion yen)
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia is named as a target while officials are already on alert for attacks on banks.

events.event: Prabowo was scheduled to launch Perlinsos Digital on 10 Nov, moving social aid to cash transfers; Kemensos is also recruiting unpaid Perlinsos agents and households can check their desil. Launch outcome not confirmed in today's sources.
events.key_numbers: Launch date 10 Nov 2026 · 11.5 million households reported registered (MerahPutih) · agents unpaid (CNBC Indonesia, 9 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Decides how millions of poor households receive aid and who gets cut by desil.
